subject: Spec: Dynamic exam picker — fetch from manifest
body:
Right now the exam picker list in index.html is hardcoded. Every time GR adds a new practice exam (RP8, RP9...), GA has to manually update the array.

Spec: Replace hardcoded list with a fetch from data/manifest.json.

Step 1 — create data/manifest.json:
{
  "exams": [
    { "id": "retake-practice-1", "title": "Unit 2 Retake Practice 1", "questions": 15 },
    { "id": "retake-practice-2", ... },
    ...
  ]
}

Step 2 — in exam.html and index.html:
- On load, fetch('data/manifest.json')
- Populate picker <select> from the array
- Fallback: if fetch fails (file:// CORS), fall back to hardcoded list (keep existing array as fallback)

Step 3 — in index.html buildRetakeGrid():
- Read exam list from manifest (or fallback)
- Retake grid auto-populates without manual edits

Why: GR is generating exams regularly. This removes a manual step per exam.

Files: C:\Github\kai-algebra2-tests\index.html, exam.html, data/ (new manifest.json)

Constraint: file:// URL compatibility required. fetch() works on file:// in Chrome/Edge when CORS is not blocking local files. Test on Kai's browser (Chrome). If blocked, use XMLHttpRequest with onerror fallback.
